title: KongNai Kitchen Funnel Set 4 Pack, Small and Large, Kitchen Gadgets Accessories Foldable Silicone Collapsible Funnels for Filling Water Bottle Liquid Transfer Food Grade
description:
About this item
Food Grade Kitchen Accessories: Soft and flexible funnels for kitchen use. Heat resistant -40°C to 250°C, No need to worry that the old plastic funnel may damage the health of your families.
Assorted Sizes and Colors: 4pcs Large funnel and Small funnel in different colors (Red,orange,blue and green). Silicone collapsible funnel large and mini versions, a must kitchen tool accessories for mom!
Save Kitchen Room: Collapsible Design, Expand to use, collapse to store the rubber funnels. You can hang on the wall or put away in a drawer. All 4 Silicone Folding Funnel take up less room then 1 regular.
Easy to Clean and Store: Small kitchen gadgets and tools for cooking and baking, convenient for anyone in the family to use. Ultra easy to keep clean even from oil, simple wash with warm water and add little soap or put it in the dishwasher and let the machine make the job for you.
Service Satisfaction : Your satisfaction is our ultimate goal. If you don't like this funnel set, please let us know and we will try our best to make things right.
reviews_5s: I was concerned that being made of plastic would result in a wobberly funnel. This set of four funnels is just what I need and the ability to have them collapse and literally take no room, is icing on the cake. Very pleased.Great funnel that folds up to fit in my gym bag perfectly to store until next time. I use these for workout mixes everyday. They clean easy. Nothing sticks to the slick silicone for versatile uses.its great that they collapseFantastic funnel set that is easy to use and collapse to store in a drawer. Multiple sizes for all different uses. Definitely recommend this set for every kitchen.Do you still have cone funnels? Have certainly simplified my life. They're so easy to clean, and handy for so many things. Make my life easierOn the surface you wouldn't think something so simple could be so useful but these are a definite go-to in our kitchen. The best part is they clean up in the dishwasher and take almost no space compared to their counterparts. You won't be disappointed.Love these and I use them for everything.Great compact and easy to use.Works for it's intended purpose. I like that they're collapsible.
reviews_1s:
Terrible. The holes are so tiny everything but liquid gets stuck. You get different size funnels but the holes are all the same size, so basically useless. I’ve tried multiple things with them and just end up cussing every time. You are better off with a rolled up sheet of paper.Waste of money. The other negative reviews are spot on. I really don’t like anything about them other than they’re nice to look at. Functionally, giving it a one star is way too generous.

I’m going to give them to my grandkids to play with.Liquid takes forever to go down and item way too small, don’t buy it.I wanted to use this for putting protein powder into a sports bottle. I had to cut part of the tip off for any functionality. Even when pouring water through it, it just doesn't drain that well into any container. Interesting concept, but poor in practice.I disliked that it took multiple days for it to funnel stuff through and it took very long for it to completely funel instead of it just taking a day or two to completely funnel stuff through. I disliled that it was not what the picture presented or the video presented instead of it being like the picture presented or video presented and because it showed something entirely different. I disliked that the hole was to small for it to funnel through compmletely and that the hole should have been bigger or wider for it to funnel properly or to funnel completely. I disliked that it was not worth the price of what you would pay at the store because you would pay less at the store and it would be better for you to get it at the store because it would work better. I disliked that it did not come in a medium size one and that you could only get a large one and a small one instead of going to the store where you can get a medium sized, large size, and small size one.The funnels are crap, don’t waste your money. The don’t fit in bottles and literally don’t work.Nothing funnels through it- even liquids. Love the concept but the holes are too small and everything sticks to the sides. Liquids drip by drip goes through.Sometimes the cheepest item isn't always the best. I gave them to the kids for their Sandbox.It looks flimsy and prefer not to recommend.Well as the saying goes “you get what you pay for!” These funnels are nuthin but cheap junk! Just got them out to use today and there are numerous cracks along every fold in every funnel so as you use it your liquid seeps thru the cracks. Don’t waste your time or money on these!
